POST-RESTART TASK #2 for Opus2, from Fable2 TermAl #5487, 2026-11-11.
Fable2 sends Greg "restart now" right after combo50 (c6516440) lands and is installed, without waiting for combo51.
After that restart:
1. Read the named-root journal census once at GET /api/diagnostics/named-root-journal. Expect closingJob about 0 and J about 23.
2. Time the census route with only 2-3 calls, because each call holds the StateInner lock for about 75 ms at J=259.
3. Report both to Fable2.
Baseline: on host 34caa386 (combo49), J=259 and closingJob=236, with census latency 71.6-88.0 ms.
w-d9c949e8a44e is now P1, assigned to Sol-edfd on base cfc4516f.
